verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Medusa documents a dedicated Payment Module (medusa-docs-24) and describes itself as a customizable commerce framework (medusa-gh-1). That suggests payment handling is extensible, but nothing shows which third-party gateways are supported or how to choose one. Missing for 10: any evidence of specific third-party gateway integrations or payment-provider selection, any evidence of multi-currency pricing or charging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
